verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a Library feature that imports papers from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF, or RIS, and says it turns the collection into a searchable, AI-powered workspace where you can 'search, find gaps, and put your collection to work.' The upload half of the story is clearly documented. The other half is not: the Research Agent and Deep Search are described as working over Consensus's 200M-paper corpus, and no evidence shows the agent synthesizing over a user's own uploaded PDFs. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the research agent or Deep Search runs over user-uploaded documents, details on full-text analysis of uploaded PDFs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
